findings.finding: The first draft allowed complete recovery without an actual retained complete smallZIP if that source disappeared.
findings.fix: Successful new recovery requires the actual independent copied/read-back complete smallZIP and external size/SHA. Archive absence/failure remains HOLD and does not suppress other diagnostics.

findings.finding: A failed HTTP transfer can leave a fixed.partial not copied by the first draft.
findings.fix: The two fixed download names have typed observations; bounded owned single-link.partial bytes are retained separately. A two-link window stays refused and cannot satisfy successful custody.

findings.finding: The first small reader copied the older successful small-reader metadata code, which only recorded provider head; its controller checked head later. The newer direct970 protocol already rejected a mismatched head before storageGET.
findings.fix: Restore direct970 metadata head_sha == pin.checkout_commit before any storageGET and retain the later acceptance check.

scope: All drafts unexecuted; no reproduced runtime counterexample or old product status change is claimed.
